title: Fraction Exponents Are Roots
premise: Cube 8^(1/3) and the exponents multiply to 1, giving 8. So 8^(1/3) must be the number whose cube is 8.
idea: Explaining how rational exponents follow from the properties of integer exponents. Reading 5^(1/3) as 5 divided by 3 is the known slip.
author: claude-stand-in
